# Node.js

Node 24 with npm and npx, on the iPhone. Everything is in the package — nothing is downloaded or compiled when you install it. JIT works; it is not a `--jitless` build.

views.title: Requires
views.text: iOS 15.0 or later · A12 or newer

views.markdown:
```
node -v && npm -v && npx --version
node -e 'require("child_process").execSync("uname -m")'
```

The second line is the one that matters: it proves `child_process` works, not just `node -v`.

- **Pure JavaScript packages install and run.** Native add-ons (`.node` files) do not load.
- **A12 or newer.** Older chips stop with SIGILL.
- **Run it from a login shell** — the terminal app does this. Over a one-shot `ssh host 'command'`, `/usr/local/bin` is not on `PATH`; use `ssh host "zsh -lc 'node -v'"`.
- **Many workers at once** can run out of address space. `NODEIOS_V8_FLAGS=--jitless` is the escape hatch.
- `shiv-sinif` from **shivtools** is the tool that needs it; the rest of shivtools does not.

[Node.js](https://nodejs.org) — OpenJS Foundation (MIT) · iOS port [nodejs-for-ios](https://github.com/realAndi/nodejs-for-ios) — andi (MIT). Packaged by muratkurt. More in the [shivtools guide](https://github.com/muratkurt/shivtools).
- Icon and depiction pages. The package contents are unchanged.

- First release: Node 24.21.0, npm 11.19.0, npx.
- Verified on RootHide and on rootless (A12), JIT included.
